QuestInfo.name: NOT a Black Wing!
QuestInfo.0: You've joined the Resistance, although it doesn't seem anyone particularly wants you around. Talk to #b#p2151003##k.
QuestInfo.1: You'll have to prove yourself if you want people's trust. Do what you can to convince #b#p2151003#, #b#p2151004#, #p2151000##k, and #b#p2151001##k that you're NOT a Black Wing in disguise.
QuestInfo.2: You are now officially part of the Resistance. Congratulations.
QuestInfo.demandSummary:
Complete the following quests

[Memory Loss] - Claudine
[Not Quite Human 1] - Checky
[Not Quite Human 2] - Checky
[Jogging Your Memory] - Elex
[Betray and You'll Pay] - Brighton
[Trust Bequeathed] - Ferdi

0.0: My apologies for the cold shoulder. Running a secret underground rebellion makes us... wary around new people. The members of the Resistance have seen more than their share of #binjustices#k in Edelstein. Be patient, and we will give you a chance to prove your loyalties.
0.1: You can start by #bhelping the others#k. It will give you a chance to get acclimated to our ranks.

yes.0: Good luck. The Resistance's trainers, including #bmyself#k, are #b#p2151000##k, #b#p2151001##k, #b#p2151002##k, and #b#p2151004##k.

no.0: If you need time to yourself, I understand, but our work must take priority.

1.0: I hear you've made quite an impression. Let me be the first to welcome you to the Resistance.
1.1: I am #b#p2151003##k. I hand out the mission assignments, and act as the doctor for this town. Your first mission is to go introduce yourself to the other instructors.

yes.0: I would like you to get to know the people of Edelstein. It's impossible for anyone to protect people if they don't know who those people are.

quest.0: Having a hard time? Each of us has a public position, allowing us to hide in plain sight. Most of the instructors will not even acknowledge you if they see you on the streets.
